text:
oscar-fin: QuantumCompute trial invoice attached — totals don't reconcile with our token-based forecasts. Invoice shows 11,200 CUs for April but amount billed is $1,320. Our telemetry suggests ~2.8M tokens which at our internal benchmark should be ~$2,800. Any idea how they define CU?

meera-eng: I exported their usage dump from the trial org. They bill in "compute-units" where CU is defined in model-steps and they apply a model factor. Quick sample from the export:```date,compute_units,model,avg_seq_len
2026-04-04,3600,redwood-open-13,200
2026-04-11,3200,redwood-open-13,240
2026-04-18,4400,redwood-open-70,1100```
lia-ops: We need a normalized per-1M-token comparison. Can someone compute an approximate tokens-per-CU using a median sequence-length assumption?
neil-sales: Rep said they'll provide a CU->token conversion table and the invoice line-level CSV. Asked if they can accept net30 and remove auto-renew from the PO.
frida-legal: Flagging their T&Cs: auto-renew + CPI-based escalator. Request we push back for either a fixed renewal schedule for 12 months or a cap of 5% annual increase. Also want explicit billing audit rights.
quantum-rep: quantum-rep: Sorry for confusion — our CU is 1 CU = 1k model-steps by default but models have multipliers. For rough guidance: short (<=256) ~1 CU per 250 tokens, medium (257-1024) ~1 CU per 500 tokens, long (>1024) ~1 CU per 1000 tokens. We'll upload a normalized CSV and a sample invoice line showing SKU, unit price, qty (CU), and total. For renewal we can do net30 and disable auto-renew on pilot contracts; enterprise auto-renew options include a 5% cap.
oscar-fin: Please post the exact sample invoice row showing the discount fields (promo credits) so we can reconcile the low total. Our procurement requires net30.
billing-bot: billing-bot: quantum_trial_invoice_apr2026.pdf uploaded (https://files.slack/quantum/quantum_trial_invoice_apr2026.pdf)
meera-eng: Quick estimate using their midline mapping: 11,200 CUs * 500 tokens/CU = 5.6M tokens. At $0.5 per 1k tokens that's $2,800. That suggests the invoice reflects a large trial credit or a lower per-1k token price. Need raw billing export to verify discounts and applied credits.
lia-ops: I'll request the raw billing CSV and detailed invoice export from Quantum billing team. ETA 36 hours.
neil-sales: If they can commit to net30 and a 10-15% first 6-month commit discount, we can move pilot -> paid. I'll push for that.
frida-legal: Do not accept auto-enrollment or unilateral escalators. Require 60-day renewal notice and a 30-day dispute window on invoices. Add a clause requiring mapping of CU->token in the SOW.
quantum-rep: quantum-rep: Uploaded normalized_rates.csv and sample_invoice_line.csv to secure link; will grant billing access. Committed to providing sample invoice with credits breakdown by EOD. Net30 ok for enterprise PO.
oscar-fin: Thanks. Action items: @lia-ops request raw billing export; @quantum-rep post sample invoice row + CSV; @neil-sales negotiate commit discount and confirm no-auto-renew on PO. Reopen thread when reconciled.
lia-ops: Requested export, ETA ~36h.
